Test Case Title: Verify quote submission fails safely when the network drops after clicking Submit
Preconditions: User is signed in to Alpha QA; the Agricultural Products Dealer quote form is open; a principal and underwriter are configured
Test Data: Bond Amount $1,000 (valid partition); Pre Pay 1 Year; Effective Date = today (default); Select Trade = Plumber; Assigned Underwriter from test data; Special Instructions = short note; network: browser goes offline when the execute request is sent
Test Steps: 1. Select the principal. 2. Enter Bond Amount 1000. 3. Select Pre Pay 1 Year. 4. Select Trade Plumber. 5. Select the Assigned Underwriter. 6. Enter a Special Instructions note. 7. Click Submit; the network drops as the quote is sent. 8. Check the form. 9. Restore the network and click Submit again.
Expected Result: Step 7: exactly one execute request is attempted; the page stays on the new quote (no bond page opens); the toast "Failed to create bond. Please try again." is shown and the banner contains "Network Error"; Submit is enabled again. Step 8: every entered value is kept. Step 9: one execute request returns HTTP 200 and creates one bond.
Actual Result: 2026-10-01 automated run (tests/ui/bond-creation/offline-submit.spec.ts): passed twice. Observed: the same network failure is shown three times (banner "1 error found — please fix before submitting · GENERAL · Network Error" plus two toasts).
